channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 12
item.description:
63 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Lingering sounds from destroyed monuments no longer persist, and new animal sound cues (sheep foot stomp, cow head shake, moo, baa) have been added.
  • Petting gestures now have correct duration, include reaction animations for cows and sheep, and support a new scratch gesture.
  • Hidden players are now ranked behind visible ones for targeting, but remain selectable when no visible targets exist.
  • Patrol boat targeting altitude logic corrected to prevent premature target loss above sea level.
  • Fixed intermittent main menu rendering issue, ensuring the menu always appears.
  • Patched PT boat targeting logic, improving accuracy for players using PT boats.

Audio & Animal Sounds

  • Lingering sounds from destroyed monuments no longer persist, and new animal sound cues (sheep foot stomp, cow head shake, moo, baa) have been added.

Animal Interaction

  • Petting gestures now have correct duration, include reaction animations for cows and sheep, and support a new scratch gesture.

Controls & Input

  • Stray gamepad stick input is ignored when another device is active, eliminating stick drift.
  • Gamepad duck‑latching issue fixed, ensuring the escape menu clears input correctly.

Combat & Targeting

  • First‑person laser weapons are functional again.
  • Hidden players are now ranked behind visible ones for targeting, but remain selectable when no visible targets exist.
  • Patrol boat targeting altitude logic corrected to prevent premature target loss above sea level.
  • Explosives attached to solar panels now have correct damage radius and visual size.

Building, Upkeep & Environment

  • Triangle spiral stairs now include the upkeep component, restoring proper decay and maintenance.
  • Arctic biome refrigeration threshold raised to 10%, preventing unintended cooling in areas with few arctic specks.
  • Player boat privileges are retained when using the building‑privilege cache.

DLC & Items

  • Halloween 2026 DLC items updated: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and the alien suit now protects the legs instead of the torso.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed intermittent main menu rendering issue, ensuring the menu always appears.
  • Patched PT boat targeting logic, improving accuracy for players using PT boats.
  • Resolved magazine drop bugs, making ammo drops spawn correctly and consistently.
  • Unified remaining magazine drop behavior with the glass AK system, standardizing drop rates and locations.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 11
item.description:
30 development commits

Structures

  • Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

Cosmetics

  • Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.

Vehicles & Mounts

  • Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

Livestock & Farming

  • Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
  • Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 10
item.description:
13 development commits

Resources & Farming

  • Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.
